name: Etavopivat
sort_evidence: Novo's 20-F filed 2026-02-04 (0000353278-26-000012) lists etavopivat (NN7535), an oral PKR activator, in Phase 3 for sickle cell disease, and NCT06612268 is recruiting with no approval.

trials.title: A Research Study Looking at Long-term Treatment With Etavopivat in People With Sickle Cell Disease or Thalassaemia
A Study to Evaluate How Well Etavopivat Works in People With Sickle Cell Disease
